rationale: SkiaCanvas::begin_layer compiles its Ganesh offscreen-surface call only under PULP_CANVAS_GANESH (SK_GANESH, the WebGL browser host), as the image-upload and backend-identity paths already do. Native builds never set the Ganesh context, so Graphite and raster layer output is unchanged; the native link no longer keeps Skia's Ganesh backend (about 1 MB). No API or authority boundary moves; this is a Pulp link-footprint fix.
